subsystems.name: Learning algorithms
subsystems.role: adjust the model's internal parameters so it improves at tasks.

subsystems.name: Model architecture
subsystems.role: organises computation into layers and memory that can represent and manipulate information.

subsystems.name: Compute infrastructure
subsystems.role: provides the raw processing power to train and run very large models.

subsystems.name: Data pipeline
subsystems.role: supplies the text, images, audio and interaction traces from which the model learns.

subsystems.name: Evaluation and alignment
subsystems.role: measures what the model can do and steers it toward safe, useful behaviour.

subsystems.name: Action and tool interface
subsystems.role: lets the system affect the world — calling APIs, controlling robots, running code.

buildSteps.title: Design a scalable architecture
buildSteps.detail: Choose a neural network design that can grow with compute and data, with mechanisms for memory and multi-step reasoning.

buildSteps.title: Assemble and curate training data
buildSteps.detail: Collect a broad corpus of text, images, audio, code and recorded interactions; filter, balance and de-duplicate it.

buildSteps.title: Pre-train on self-supervised objectives
buildSteps.detail: Train the model to predict missing parts of the data, forcing it to build general representations of language, perception and reasoning.

buildSteps.title: Scale training across many accelerators
buildSteps.detail: Distribute the job over thousands of chips with efficient communication and fault tolerance, so that scaling continues to improve capability.

buildSteps.title: Fine-tune with human feedback
buildSteps.detail: Use demonstrations and preference comparisons to teach the model to follow instructions and avoid harmful outputs.

buildSteps.title: Add memory and tool use
buildSteps.detail: Give the model a persistent store it can read and write, and the ability to call search, calculators, code interpreters or other software.

buildSteps.title: Enable continual learning
buildSteps.detail: Develop methods that let the model absorb new experience over time without forgetting earlier skills — a problem known as catastrophic forgetting.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate for generality and deploy with safeguards
buildSteps.detail: Test on a wide range of unfamiliar tasks, then run the system inside sandboxes with monitoring and human override.

prerequisites.why: transformer-style networks already improve predictably as they grow.
training runs already use thousands of specialised chips.
models learn from web-scale text, image and code collections.
works for narrow alignment but does not yet guarantee broad safety.
today's models are trained once and cannot steadily accumulate new skills.
we cannot yet reliably inspect or constrain the internal reasoning of large models.

pathway.milestone: large foundation models that handle text, images and code, and can call tools
pathway.unlocks: useful narrow assistants and a base for further research.

pathway.milestone: agentic systems that plan, remember and act over long horizons with limited supervision
models that learn continually from experience and improve their own architecture or training
pathway.unlocks: faster progress toward general capabilities, with rising safety concerns.

pathway.milestone: a system that matches or exceeds human performance across most intellectual tasks
pathway.unlocks: broad economic and scientific acceleration — if alignment and control are solved.
